scope: Read-only local exploration. No production ranking or Spotify mutation.

library.representation: Existing pooled excerpt CLAP; not full-song C

frozen_C.representation: Exact frozen Stage 5E full-song CLAP C

checks: song list starts with bounded rendering
all songs remain reachable through list pagination
displayed ranked scores exactly match snapshot
Chromium audio plays and seeks to 60 seconds
bridges mode clears incompatible area filter
area focus restores its internal connections
bridge inspection and exact connection details
frozen full-song C is distinct and has 100 songs
real WebGL node hover and click select the correct song
zoom, reset and keyboard controls with reduced motion
local import preserves non-CLAP score direction and supplied communities
existing organizer and return navigation preserved
WebGL failure preserves usable song-list inspection
OAuth error can return to song space even when hash is already root

limitations: Headless Chromium used software WebGL; initial full-library load was 8.94 seconds on this machine. Layout runs in a worker.
No universal similarity or playlist-fit claim. Graph layout distances and communities are exploratory.
Full-song C covers only the frozen 100 tracks. No additional audio inference was run.
Real-library screenshots and JSON exports stay local and are not published.

review.correctness: Scores and directional ranks are preserved; input validation, worker failures, same-ID imports, and mutually exclusive filters checked.
review.readability: Feature modules separate input parsing, layout worker, WebGL view, inspector, and local media bridge. Formatting follows frontend conventions.
review.architecture: Provider interface and versioned JSON contract admit alternative similarity functions; existing organizer/auth remain separate.
review.security: Opt-in loopback bridge, strict media paths and origins, GET/HEAD only; no credentials or private library exports in bundle/Git.
review.performance: Worker-based deterministic layout, WebGL rendering, bounded initial lists with pagination, no idle animation or new inference.
